glosses: umrzeć
To fall asleep.

examples.text: After two glasses of whiskey, Tom soon dropped off in front of the television.
And when the Boy dropped off to sleep, the Rabbit would snuggle down close under his little warm chin and dream, with the Boy's hands clasped close round him all night long.

glosses: To deliver; to deposit or leave; to allow passengers to alight.

examples.text: Can you drop the kids off at school?
I'll drop off your books when I see you tonight.
After dropping off travellers at Foregate Street, my train terminates at Shrub Hill - a station which boasts one of the best selection [sic] of semaphore signals left in the country.

glosses: To fall off:
To drop from, fall from.

examples.text: The leaves were slowly dropping off the tree.

glosses: To fall off:
To drop, fall.

examples.text: The leaves hung on until the end of November, then dropped off quickly.

glosses: To end a connection with a telephone queue, either by hanging up or after being served or processed.

examples.text: As soon as a caller drops off, we'll have an open line and maybe you can reach us then.

glosses: To lessen or reduce.

examples.text: Near-synonyms: taper off, dwindle
Sales have dropped off in recent months.

glosses: To die.
To abandon or give up on (something); to be abandoned or given up on.

examples.text: My lawyer said some of those charges will be dropped off.
If you ignore them, the fees won't just drop off.

glosses: To pass from a state of wakefulness into sleep.

examples.text: She wakened in sharp panic, bewildered by the grotesquerie of some half-remembered dream in contrast with the harshness of inclement fact, drowsily realizing that since she had fallen asleep it had come on to rain smartly out of a shrouded sky.

glosses: To be affected by paresthesia; to go numb.

examples.text: My left leg has fallen asleep!

glosses: To die (often seen on gravestones).

examples.text: And he kneeled downe, and cried with a loud voice, Lord lay not this sinne to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleepe. And Saul was consenting vnto his death.
